summary: A guided review now has a persistent notes sidebar, clear entry and completion states, and an active-guide entry point. Follow the explanation data into the editor, then inspect save boundaries, lifecycle reservations, recovery, and byte-preserving rendering. Unclaimed changes remain available in heuristic order.
